items.title: Formas.AI unveils native agentic 3D modeller
items.excerpt: Forma.AI unveils Cartesian, a native agentic 3D modeller for the physical world, where editable geometry meets spatial design reasoning
items.rationale: New product launch: an agentic modeller that outputs editable geometry, which changes how spatial and product designers block out form.

items.title: Adobe's Prompt to Edit Lightroom: Restore Old Photos Fast
items.excerpt: Adobe's new Prompt to Edit feature in Lightroom uses AI to restore old photographs, fix focus issues, colorize black-and-white images, and correct color casts. Hands-on results with Color Restoration and custom prompts.
items.rationale: Hands-on with a new Lightroom feature (prompt-driven restoration and colour correction) that image editors can use right away.

items.title: ChatGPT Sites hosts your website in public beta, with no data residency at launch
items.excerpt: ChatGPT will host a website, a web app or a game for subscribers on five of its plans, and OpenAI's documentation for the feature puts one limit in
items.rationale: New public-beta feature: ChatGPT now hosts sites and web apps directly, so a prototype can go live without a separate host. The piece also flags the data-residency limit.

items.title: Free Premiere on Android is exactly the direction Adobe should be taking
items.excerpt: Adobe's free Premiere for Android brings mobile video editing with AI features such as Enhance Audio, with Firefly-powered Generative Fill, Image-to-Video and Generate Sound Effects on generative credits.
items.rationale: Covers a concrete release: Premiere on Android is free, with Firefly generative tools, which puts AI video editing on the phone.

items.title: Manycore's Aholo Lux3D Turns Three Photos Into an Editable 3D Asset via Agent and Blender
items.excerpt: A Leiphone test shows Manycore's Aholo Lux3D generating an editable bronze sculpture from three photos, with an AI agent orchestrating the job and Blender finishing it.
items.rationale: A tested photo-to-editable-3D pipeline, with an agent running the job and Blender finishing it, that 3D artists can use.
